name: @vellira-ui/tokens
description: Design tokens for Vellira Design System
author: Roman Bakurov

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('dist')) for (const entry of fs.readdirSync('dist')) { if (entry !== 'css') fs.rmSync('dist/' + entry, { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm run build:tokens && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate:types:check && pnpm run preservation:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run generate:types:check && pnpm run preservation:check && vitest run
